claims.text: The source defines RePaint inpainting: each reverse step samples the known region from forward-noised input and the unknown region from the model, then mask-combines; resampling diffuses back-and-forth (T=250, jump 10, 10 resamples) to harmonise; preservation target is exact unmasked pixels with mask-defined locality including extreme Half/Expand masks.

Reported numbers: 256px CelebA-HQ/ImageNet, 1000 votes per comparison, 95% preference for RePaint on Wide/Narrow/thin/thick masks; ablation 32-image Wide LPIPS 0.168 (1 resample) to 0.134 (4 resamples) at slowdown cost; jump-10/resample-10 LPIPS 0.068 with 56.25% votes vs LaMa.

limitations.text: Slow (250x10 evaluations); LPIPS penalises valid diverse fills; thin-structure artefacts; failure cases in App F.
